podcast.body: A demo of this song, intended for the unreleased Mission Impossible 2 soundtrack, was discovered being traded online, which, along with the free trading of all their other songs, prompted Metallica to file a lawsuit against Napster on April 30, 2000. "They found that a demo of their song I Disappeared from the still unreleased Mission Impossible 2 soundtrack was already bouncing around online."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The 100 Greatest Rock Moments of the Millennium So Far - Part 7: (40-31)

podcast.body: This unreleased demo track was found circulating on the Napster network in the spring of 2000, prompting Metallica's lawsuit against Napster. The band had previously experienced an unreleased song shared as an MP3, making this incident a breaking point. "When Metallica realized that this unauthorized, unreleased demo of I Disappeared was circulating around the planet via Napster, the decision was made that this could not be tolerated."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The 00's Part 1: The Sad State of Rock
